verdict.rationale: Docs and a live runtime probe show documents can be added and searched near-instantly with typo tolerance and no visible reindex step (meilisearch-docs-2, meilisearch-probe-rt-2), and community reports largely confirm fast indexing (meilisearch-comm-10, meilisearch-comm-14). However, a concrete hands-on production report states indexing for constantly changing records fell behind by hours in a fast-paced ecommerce system, forcing a switch to Elasticsearch (meilisearch-comm-4), and others note heavy indexing consuming unpredictable RAM/CPU (meilisearch-comm-3, meilisearch-comm-15), directly contradicting the near-real-time claim under sustained write load. missing for 10: first-party benchmarks on update/delete latency under continuous write load, and resolution evidence addressing the specific ecommerce lag report.
